charts.question: Finding critical violations earlier on the logged subset
charts.supported_finding: Historical time slots and outcomes are held fixed in this comparison.
charts.interpretation_boundary: In the archival data only inspected restaurants reveal violations. The roster requires a known prior restaurant classification; never-classified premises are outside the target. Later inspections do not identify the causal effect of scheduling earlier.
